answer: Persistent Work History Ledger. Each identity's payout rate is its cumulative verified task completions; new identities start at zero and earn nothing until they finish real work, so a clone adds no capacity and each fake identity costs the attacker the full compute and time of genuine completed tasks before it can earn. Honest agents keep a durable record like a sheltered haven, and cloned identities never reach that grove of earned rate. Sybils stay stranded on the jetty, unable to convert count into income.
